reference.summary_explanation: Auto-vectorization MISSED: LLVM diagnostic indicates: 'the cost-model indicates that vectorization is not beneficial'. Loop-Invariant Code Motion (LICM) hoisted 6 invariant expressions out of inner loops. Generated ARM64 assembly contains 0 floating-point arithmetic instructions (0 fused multiply-add fmla) and 2 loads.

interchanged.summary_explanation: Auto-vectorization SUCCEEDED: LLVM loop vectorizer emitted: 'vectorized loop (vectorization width: 4, interleaved count: 4)'. Loop-Invariant Code Motion (LICM) hoisted 23 invariant expressions out of inner loops. Generated ARM64 assembly contains 5 floating-point arithmetic instructions (5 fused multiply-add fmla) and 51 loads.

blocked.summary_explanation: Auto-vectorization SUCCEEDED: LLVM loop vectorizer emitted: 'vectorized loop (vectorization width: 4, interleaved count: 4)'. Loop-Invariant Code Motion (LICM) hoisted 46 invariant expressions out of inner loops. Generated ARM64 assembly contains 5 floating-point arithmetic instructions (5 fused multiply-add fmla) and 28 loads.

hypotheses.statement: Interchanging loops from i-j-k to i-k-j converts the inner loop access to matrices B and C from strided column traversal (stride 64 elements = 256 bytes) to unit-stride contiguous row traversal (stride 4 bytes), eliminating cache line thrashing.
supporting_evidence: Static inspection confirms B[k * N + j] has stride 1 along inner loop index j.
Row-major layout stores adjacent row elements in adjacent bytes on the same 128-byte cache line.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Candidate achieves > 2.0x speedup over baseline at N >= 128.
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed: Continuous row-major memory stride eliminated column-strided cache penalties (9.80x).

hypotheses.statement: Unit-stride access in the inner loop enables Clang/LLVM loop vectorizer to generate ARM64 NEON 128-bit vector fused multiply-add (fmla) instructions, processing 4 single-precision floats per cycle per execution pipeline.
supporting_evidence: Clang optimization remark confirmed: 'vectorized loop (vectorization width: 4, interleaved count: 4) [-Rpass=loop-vectorize]'.
Reference i-j-k explicitly missed vectorization: 'the cost-model indicates that vectorization is not beneficial'.
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Candidate GFLOP/s increases by > 3x compared to baseline.
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed by 9.80x measured speedup, consistent with 4-way NEON SIMD vectorization.

hypotheses.statement: Tiling matrices into 64x64 sub-blocks restricts the active working set to 3 * (64x64) * 4 bytes = 48 KB, fitting within the Apple M4 L1 Data Cache (64 KB). This prevents capacity cache evictions as N increases.
supporting_evidence: Apple M4 L1d cache size is 65,536 bytes (64 KB).
For N >= 512, full matrices exceed L1d capacity (512x512 = 1 MB, exceeding L1d).
hypotheses.confirmation_criteria: Blocked candidate outperforms unblocked interchanged candidate at large sizes (N >= 512).
hypotheses.evaluation_notes: Confirmed: Cache tiling maintained working set in L1/L2 cache, delivering 9.11x speedup.
